[color=#00ffff]Description
[/color][/b]
Tired of bouncing back to the title screen every time you switch saves?
This mod cuts out that extra step.
When you choose [b]“Exit to Title”[/b] from the in-game menu, the game will skip the title screen and jump straight to the [b]Load Game[/b] menu instead. That means:

[list]
[*][b]No more waiting on the title screen[/b] just to click “Load.”
[*][b]Faster save swapping[/b] when you play multiple farms.
[*]Saves you a few seconds [i]every[/i] time you change files – it adds up!
[/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]How it works[/color][/b][list]
[*]On reaching the title screen, the mod automatically opens the [b]Load Game[/b] menu for you.
[*]If you need to access the normal title screen (Options, Mods, etc.), just [b]hold [code]LeftShift[/code][/b]
while on the title screen to temporarily disable the auto-open for that visit[youtube]3pQpBjwpF_M[/youtube][/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]Configuration
[/color][/b]
In the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], you can:
[list]
[*][b]Auto-open Load Game menu[/b]
[list]
[*][b]On[/b] – Always open Load Game automatically at the title screen. [b][color=#ffff00]Note that once you select Always and wanted to go to title screen later, you will have to hold left SHIFT and click back or edit under config.json file. [/color][/b]
[*][b]Off[/b] – Do nothing; title behaves normally.
[/list][/list]You can also toggle this by editing the mod’s [code]config.json[/code] if you prefer.

Downloads.Description: When enabled, you will always be directed to save loader instead of title screen. if you want to access the title screen, you need to hold LEFT SHIFT and click BACK to get to title screen or turn off under config.json file (False).
